Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 0
Reason for Mistake: The Planner miscalculated atomic mass by adding electrons to protons and neutrons (20 + 21 + 20 = 61), conflating mass number with total particle count. Atomic mass (mass number) is the sum of protons and neutrons only, giving 41 (Option C).
